description: This file defines the ResultVisitor interface, which provides methods to handle different types of command results (empty, mutation, query, error) within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It is designed to be implemented by classes that process these outcomes, with generic type support for event types.

classes.name: ResultVisitor
classes.description: Interface for evaluating command results of various types (empty, mutation, query, error) with generic support for event types.

methods.name: onEmpty
methods.description: Default method to handle empty result; does nothing by default.

methods.name: onMutation
methods.description: Handles mutation results, with parameters for command, event, response headers, and flags indicating creation/deletion.

methods.name: onQuery
methods.description: Handles query results, with parameters for command and response headers.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles error results, with parameters for the error and the command that caused it.
